question: How does the 8,000 Grade-A automatic positive plus 24,000 same-source matched-negative dataset behave under the frozen YOLO11s imgsz=960 recipe, when all image variants remain grouped by event and the result is evaluated as completed-history research rather than a live tip detector?

immediate_context: 还有哪些要注意的细节 我们马上要去训练了
P0/P1禁训门是啥  不读holdout、不promote、不部署。没必要 都可以做
owner_authorization.interpretation: The Owner explicitly overrides the repository P0/P1 no-training gate for this completed-history research run and permits later holdout, promotion and deployment actions. Permission is recorded, but this launch itself reads no holdout and performs no promotion or deployment. The model's 2-9 post-core input bars remain incompatible with the causal tip/tip-1/tip-2 production path unless a separate architecture and acceptance decision is made after results exist.

single_variable.name: immutable training dataset treatment
single_variable.reference_dataset: 10,000 older weak positives plus 30,000 legacy matched negatives
single_variable.treatment_dataset: 8,000 Grade-A automatic positives plus 24,000 newly same-source matched negatives
single_variable.causal_attribution_limit: The positive selection, negative cohort and total image count move together as one owner-authorized dataset artifact. Metric differences cannot be attributed to any one component.

immutable_inputs.split: global chronological cutoff 2025-12-01T00:00:00Z with 150 15m bars purged on both sides; all variants of one event stay in one split

evaluation.static_val: Reload best.pt on the unchanged 4,800-image chronological val split at imgsz=960 and report overall plus per-class P/R/mAP50/mAP50-95.
evaluation.negative_surface: At frozen conf=0.25 and IoU=0.7, report false-positive-image rate, boxes per 1,000 images and maximum confidence on all 3,600 empty-label val images, split hard versus easy.
evaluation.event_surface: Group the 1,200 positive val variants into 155 independent events; report earliest post=2 hit rate, first-hit post-bar delay, any-hit event recall and duplicate-box rate.
evaluation.post_freeze_holdout: Owner authorized a later consumption, but it must be separately recorded after best.pt and the evaluation code are frozen; already viewed recent-five-day and ETH30d surfaces are not clean unseen Gold.
evaluation.financial_metrics_not_applicable: This is a completed-history detector experiment, not an execution backtest.
